messages:
Maya (Partnerships): New co-sell POC with Helix. They want a shared pilot next week. Key asks: SAML SSO, HSM/KMS options, staging IP allowlist, and a 2-week pilot price for ~100k tokens/day. Who owns infra and partner handoff?

Priya (Sales AE): I can own pricing/comms. Need a ballpark by EOD to confirm. Prefer reserved pool if cost-effective.

Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll own infra. Suggest small dedicated pool (2x A10) + hosted overflow. Will size for peaks, not just average tokens. Posting rough numbers soon.

Jordan (Partner Eng): Helix will host UI in their VPC. They need SAML metadata and three egress IPs to allowlist. I'll share CIDRs and firewall window once I have them.

Nate (Security): We support AWS KMS and CloudHSM; pure HSM keys for hosted require customer-managed HSM or Private deployment. I'll drop the sec questionnaire link and flag any blockers.

Alex (Solutions Eng): Creating helix-staging tenant and scoping entitlements now. Example flow: create tenant -> upload SAML metadata -> set quota -> generate short-lived key for testing.

deploy-bot: tenant created helix-staging-1766 by Alex (Solutions Eng). Console: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/t-helix-staging-1766

Jordan (Partner Eng): Helix CIDRs for allowlist: 203.0.113.12/32, 198.51.100.45/32, 198.51.100.46/32. They will open firewall window Wed 09:00-11:00 PT.

Priya (Sales AE): I'll draft a 2-week pilot addendum. Recommend a pilot discount (25%) on reserved capacity, overflow at list.

Nate (Security): Sec questionnaire: https://docs.redwood.ai/sec/pilot-q. Note: HSM-backed key custody options listed; will return completed questionnaire by EOD.

Maya (Partnerships): Great. Owners: Alex infra, Jordan partner handoff, Priya pricing, Nate security, Maya runbook. Target: tenant + SAML metadata by Tue. Sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.
